for: short engineering blog posts about a change we made and what it cost

card.purpose: weigh whether the same trade would work for their team

change: Open on the number of pages, not on a general statement.
always: Never end on a question to the reader.

requests.task: Write a post about cutting our on-call pages by deleting alerts nobody acted on.
Write a post about replacing our staging environment with per-PR previews.
Write a post about how we got our test suite from 38 minutes to 6.
Write a post about capping design docs at two pages.
